answer: One workable design: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because velvet only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, marble is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any echo approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
